items.title: Quasi-coherent modules on the simplicial total site are exactly the cartesian ones with quasi-coherent components
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: Characterization lemma (statement 2816-2825, proof 2827-2892): the forward direction is a complete presentation-restriction argument promoting isomorphisms on coverings to cartesianness; the converse direction constructs the total-site presentation in full and ends with a short exactness verification marked 'we omit the details' (recorded in the notes). H2: hands-on sheaf-of-modules argument over the total site.
